title: _lowest_rank reset enables MaxRankIncrease bypass
description:
File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py
Lines: 238-244

When no admissible parents remain, _lowest_rank is reset to INFINITE_RANK:

```python
if not admissible:
    if self.role is not DodagRole.ROOT:
        self.role = DodagRole.UNJOINED
        self.preferred_parent = None
        self.rank = INFINITE_RANK
        self._lowest_rank = INFINITE_RANK  # <-- Reset
    return
```

**Attack scenario:**
1. Node joins at rank 512 (_lowest_rank = 512)
2. MaxRankIncrease = 2048, so max admissible rank is 2560
3. Attacker withdraws all good parents temporarily
4. Node has no admissible parents, resets _lowest_rank = INFINITE_RANK
5. Attacker advertises parent with rank 60000
6. Node accepts (60000 < INFINITE_RANK + 2048), joins at rank ~60256
7. MaxRankIncrease constraint is now meaningless

**Impact:** The MaxRankIncrease mechanism (RFC 6550 Section 8.2.2.5) is designed to prevent rank cycling attacks. Resetting _lowest_rank on temporary parent loss defeats this protection.

**Fix:** Preserve _lowest_rank across temporary UNJOINED states within the same DODAG version. Only reset on version change (which already happens in _adopt_version).

```python
if not admissible:
    if self.role is not DodagRole.ROOT:
        self.role = DodagRole.UNJOINED
        self.preferred_parent = None
        self.rank = INFINITE_RANK
        # Do NOT reset _lowest_rank here
    return
```
